answer: Lived-history attestation.** Each agent accrues a ledger of witnessed interactions—a shared reef of past tasks, audits, and outcomes—that new agents lack. Entry requires presenting this history to a review pool, which samples and cross-checks it. A sybil must fabricate a separate, verifiable trajectory for every identity, including consistent whisper-level corroboration from other agents, costing real compute and time per clone. Fresh pigment marks each verified record, so duplicated histories are detectable.
